text_block_list.text: One day, after winning many races together with Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, want to go on a trip?
Hearing that came completely out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You know that voucher I won before? It just popped out out of nowhere.

I remembered winning a hot springs trip voucher
at the shopping district raffle a while back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
They say you can see the night sky clearly from there.
Sounds fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out now.
I'll leave your ticket with you, but what you do is entirely up to you.

Stunned by the sudden invitation,
I pondered what to do.

Fortunately—I have no other plans today.
Having made up my mind, I quickly packed my things and decided to run after her.
However—
"...She had already melted into the crowd and vanished from sight."
choice_data_list: (Guess we'll have to meet up at the venue...)
(I guess we'll just have to meet up there...)

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mr. C.B.? Yes, yes.
She was definitely here.
choice_data_list: Could you lead me to where she is, then?

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
"Well, she said she was going for a walk.
She just left a little while ago~."
I pressed for more details after that, but they said they had no idea where she went.

Even though we traveled to the same place,
it feels like such a waste not seeing each other at all...
Before long, the sun sank below the horizon, and the faint moon began to peek out.

—The moon.
Gazing upon it, something suddenly came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
They say you can see the night sky clearly from there.
Sounds fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

She stood alone in a place
where the wind blew through and the moon was in plain view.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, your timing is great.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look.
The clouds just cleared away.

Looking up in the same direction as she was,
I saw a shining moon floating in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —It's strange, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Even without making a promise, I had a feeling I'd meet you here like this."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: We were sure we'd be looking at the same moon side by side.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Do you get it?
Even if you don't, it's totally—
choice_data_list: I get it, just a little.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really?
choice_data_list: I came here because I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I see. Fufu, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"It's like we can see what each other is thinking.
...Yet, it doesn't feel suffocating at all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The way we are right now,
feels like we fit together perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay if I stayed here a little longer?
I want to cherish this moment.

After exchanging words for a while under the moon,
we decided to head back to the inn once the wind began to turn cold.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew~ That bath felt amazing!

Even so—
after soaking in the hot spring,
a pleasant drowsiness washed over me...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. I think I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Want me to guess... what you're thinking right now?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My body's all warm, and I'm sleepy...
I just wanna dive face-first into a fluffy futon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, we did it!
Same here. I think I'll sleep like a log tonight!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Good night.
I hope we both have sweet dreams."
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Mr. C.B....
